note: Spec pass 2026-10-15: groupings by an agent from the claims it read. No claim tests flexible grouping itself; this finding gathers the claims on its comparator, fixed grouping by attainment, and on group composition. The three Chicago double-dose claims are reports from one research programme (Nomi and Allensworth 2010, 2013, 2014).

findings.question: Does grouping learners by attainment (streaming, tracking, homogeneous groups) help or harm their learning compared with mixed groups?
